about: Stage obs-fixes: the freeze record its observer changes need (proposal; NOT applied: data/targets.json is frozen and this branch does not edit it). The fixes of docs/staging/obs-fixes-prereg.md change src/field, so the protocol hash moves from the frozen 5d4fa5a2a500bce6. Applying this file means: replace `protocolFreeze` in data/targets.json by `protocolFreeze` below with the current record under `previous`, append `protocolLog` below, and re-read the hash (scripts/field-metrics.ts --protocol-hash) on the commit it lands on. A new freeze is the user's decision; so is the treatment of the held-out rows (`userDecisions`).

protocolFreeze.stage: Track E freeze + obs-fixes (rare-event rows counted by outcome: T-LET-1, -2, -3, -6; T-DEM-9 census year)
protocolFreeze.at: TO BE SET when applied (ISO time of the freeze commit; scripts/e-bench.ts staleRows compares run dates with it)
protocolFreeze.hashNote: scripts/field-metrics.ts --protocol-hash at obs-fixes 1dce79f, with no row flag changed. It changes if any file of src/field, the compare or scenario scripts, or a row's flags change before the freeze (for example if T-LET-2, -3, -6 are marked compromised): re-read it then.
protocolFreeze.registryNote: REGISTRY_HASH at obs-fixes 1dce79f (track-e e0cf866); the current record still carries 16853ddc0f0a7318.

observerRevised.T-LET-1: obs-fixes: a failed infanticidal attack is no killing; a fight death inside a community that a team detected is an observed killing; truth counts fight deaths
observerRevised.T-LET-2: obs-fixes: victims are those of T-LET-1's killings (a failed infanticidal attack is no killing; detected fight deaths are)
observerRevised.T-LET-3: obs-fixes: intercommunity killings only, one truth record per victim (an attack's start is no record)
observerRevised.T-LET-6: obs-fixes: intercommunity killings only, one per victim (an attack's start is no killing)
observerRevised.T-DEM-9: obs-fixes: census at the end of each 365-day observation year (was 365.25 days: no census in a 365-day run, none at the end of a three-year run)

protocolFreeze.note: scripts/e-bench.ts reads `observerRevised`: a saved run made under an older protocol is listed as needing a fresh run on these rows and they are never summed. Where a saved run kept its end checkpoint, scripts/obs-rederive.ts re-derives the five rows from it without a simulation (reported beside the run, never written into it).

protocolLog.by: obs-fixes (agent; registered in docs/staging/obs-fixes-prereg.md at 8d0e4ae before any code, amendment 1 at 74d28a7 before its code)
protocolLog.seen: Part D1's counts on the saved 12-month runs (docs/staging/e-rebaseline.md: S39's group 4 observed killings of which 2 were infants that lived; 3 truth killings: 1 infanticide, 2 fight wounds). Nothing was computed with a fix applied before the fix and its tests were committed. Amendment 1 was written after the first re-derivation (no fight-kill event in 60 seed-runs; one fight death of a followed focal animal with a detected decided-conflict record and no captured event).
protocolLog.param: src/field/protocols.ts: an `infanticide` interaction is logged as `infanticide` only when its target died in it, else as `infanticide-attack`; truth.kills keeps fatal records, one per victim; a `fight-kill` event when a contest inside a community that a team detected (its all-occurrence event, or its decided-conflict record) leaves a participant dead of its wounds; truth.fightKillings. src/field/metrics.ts: killings() counts `kill`, `infanticide` and `fight-kill` events; T-LET-1's truth = (stats.killings + fightKillings) / community-years; T-LET-3 and T-LET-6 on intercommunity killings, one per victim; T-DEM-9's census year 365.25 -> 365 days.
protocolLog.reason: bug, against each row's written definition: T-LET-1 'All intercommunity and within-community killings (observed + inferred)' (an attack the infant survived is no killing; a fight death inside a community is one); T-LET-3 'per intercommunity attack'; T-LET-6 'Share of intercommunity killings by patrolling parties'; T-DEM-9 'Share of individuals > 3 y with a snare injury' (census; the observer's year is 365 days everywhere else, so no census closed in a 365-day run).
protocolLog.verdicts: Re-derived from the end checkpoints of the saved 12-month runs (scripts/obs-rederive.ts; 20 seed-runs = 60 community-years per group; before -> after, pooled). S39: T-LET-1 4 -> 3 killings (0.067 -> 0.050, inconclusive both), T-LET-2 0/4 -> 0/3 (fail both), T-LET-3 0.33 (n 2, fail) -> insufficient, T-LET-6 0/4 (fail) -> insufficient, T-DEM-9 insufficient -> 6/869 = 0.007 (fail). Wadging 0.5: T-LET-1 1 -> 1, T-LET-3 0.25 (n 2, fail) -> insufficient, T-DEM-9 insufficient -> 6/866 (fail). Wadging 0.25: T-LET-1 4 -> 3, T-LET-2 2/4 -> 1/3 (inconclusive both), T-LET-3 0.5 (n 4, fail) -> insufficient, T-LET-6 0/3 (fail) -> insufficient, T-DEM-9 insufficient -> 8/861 = 0.009 (fail).
protocolLog.class: bug + definition text (after the freeze: needs a new freeze; held-out rows T-LET-2, -3, -6 per protocolPolicy rule 4)

userDecisions: Whether to take the new freeze (hash above) so that e-bench lists the five rows of every older run as needing a fresh run.

Held-out rows T-LET-2, T-LET-3 and T-LET-6 are touched after the freeze. protocolPolicy rule 4 as written compromises them (reported, never counted). The Track E freeze instead re-froze its revised held-out rows by user decision, flagged protocolRevisedPostHoc (all three already carry that flag). Marking them compromised changes the hash again.

T-DEM-9 now scores at 12 months, on one year of new injuries from a start without any (S39's group 6 of 869, against a band of 0.1-0.3 for a standing prevalence). It is a fitted row, so it enters every fitted sum from 12 months on unless it is flagged (for example notScorable below a stated run length). The row itself is left as it is.
